records.title: About Our Program (Grandview School)
records.summary: Grandview School is inside Grandview Children's Centre in Ajax and admits children through a referral, not by address. A Grandview therapist submits the referral to the Admission Committee by January 31 and decisions are made by April 1. The child must be a Grandview client and old enough for at least junior kindergarten (four by December 31); placements are one year and far fewer than referrals. The page also lists clinical criteria and short post-surgery placements. Call the school for a tour.

records.title: Special Education Report 2026-2027 (PDF)
records.summary: The authority's special education plan. IPRC identification is not formally made for Grandview students; parents take part through the referral, intake and transition meetings instead. Each student gets an IEP with a transition plan to help them move to their home school board, and the admissions committee also reviews moves in and out of the school.

records.title: Resources for Families (School Council)
records.summary: At Grandview School the School Council also serves as the Special Education Advisory Committee. It includes parents of current and former students (the majority), a teacher, a non-teaching staff member and a Grandview Children's Centre representative, plus the principal. It meets about four times a year.

records.title: Resources for Families (Partners in Education)
records.summary: Families can join the School Community Council or in-school activities and curriculum days; no experience is needed. To join, contact the school office or your child's educator. The page also links the 2026-2027 parent handbook.

records.title: Multi-Year Access Plan (PDF)
records.summary: The authority's AODA multi-year accessibility plan, posted on its Plans and Reports page with a 2025 accessibility compliance report. The plan notes it is shared on the school website and available in accessible formats.

records.title: Parent Handbook 2026-2027 (PDF)
records.summary: A transportation form is completed at registration and a third-party company runs the buses, but space is limited and filing the form does not guarantee a place. The handbook calls busing a privilege, not a right. The families page lists Stock Transportation at 705-357-3187.
